title: Slider
overview: A range control for intensity or grade when a precise typed number is not required.
apply_when: Volume, brightness, saturation; pair with a number field when precision is required.
not_when: A public question page that needs an exact answer (GOV.UK: no range sliders).

role.overview: A value on a continuous or stepped scale.
role.apply_when: Intensity, volume, a grade they feel.
role.not_when: A question that should be typed or a GOV.UK question page (no range sliders).

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.not_when: Two values faked as one thumb.

composition.overview: Two thumbs for a min and max.

state.overview: Pointer is over the thumb or track.
state.not_when: Hover is the only value cue.

state.overview: Keyboard or AT is on the thumb. Must stay visible.
The value cannot change. Must stay perceivable.

state.apply_when: Pointer or keys are changing the value.
state.not_when: A sticky drag with no value text.

accessibility.overview: The slider names what is being set.
The current value is available as text, not color on a track.
accessibility.not_when: A thumb with no aria-valuenow / visible number.

keyboard.overview: Arrows change the value by a small step.
Page Up/Down or Home/End jump a larger step when that is the house.
